subject: Onboarding: three questions after the scope change
body: 1) D-onboarding-007 (proposed): voice-first with Web Speech in and out, Claude (claude-sonnet-5-5) driving the playbook, plus typed and offline scripted fallbacks. Or would you rather use a realtime speech-to-speech API? 2) D-onboarding-010 (proposed): on stage, run playbook sections 1 and 4 live and pre-fill 2 and 3 from a rehearsal (~90 s)? 3) Contrast safety: what counts as too heavy to explore (a self-rating threshold and/or a word list)? Today the guide asks once for a smaller one, then skips section 3. My earlier questions (D-onboarding-002, calibration length) are superseded.
